Patient engagement page. Patient access to clinical summaries and images, family record management, secure messaging, digital intake forms, patient-reported outcomes, online payment, patient education resources.
Telehealth page. HIPAA-compliant video visits from any device, no installation required, screen sharing, messaging threads, file sharing. Free for providers and patients.
